notes: Samsung prints Dimension & Weight as WIDTH x HEIGHT x DEPTH; mapped to height/width/depth accordingly. Samsung never publishes a crease shape (teardrop/U) for any Flip, so hinge.crease is null throughout. hinge.max_angle_deg left null: Samsung states Flex Mode working angles, not a maximum hinge angle. First Flip generation for which Samsung publishes a SINGLE folded thickness (15.1mm) rather than a hinge/sagging range, because the new Flex Hinge closes the gap - depth_at_hinge is therefore null (not unknown: Samsung no longer publishes a separate hinge figure). Cover screen jumps to 3.4in here from 1.9in on Flip4 - measured independently from this release.
